title: Spectral measure blowup for Hadamard subfactors
description:
We study the spectral measures of the Hadamard subfactors coming from the deformed Fourier matrices FX ⊗Q FY. After preliminaries on small-index graphs and exceptional root measures, we express the law through a Gram matrix over a compact abelian group, interpret this as an abelian covering, and compute the moment growth. At index 6 the generic law comes from the honeycomb and kagome lattices, and finite cases correspond to Eisenstein ideals. Circulant families at square index give planar random walk laws. We locate the first Jacobi defect and construct finite-depth laws with arbitrarily long generic moment sequences.

This record contains the paper (010.pdf, 010.tex) and the programs which check its computations (code010).
